% Written by `lab paper game-rating`; do not edit by hand.
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{lL}
\toprule
Feature & What it counts \\
\midrule
\texttt{loss\_mean} & What the player's moves lost on average, in points of winning chances. \\
\texttt{loss\_median} & The median of what the player's moves lost, in points of winning chances. \\
\texttt{loss\_worst} & What the player's costliest move lost, in points of winning chances. \\
\texttt{loss\_over\_5} & The share of the player's moves that lost more than 5 points of winning chances. \\
\texttt{loss\_over\_10} & The share of the player's moves that lost more than 10 points of winning chances. \\
\texttt{loss\_over\_20} & The share of the player's moves that lost more than 20 points of winning chances. \\
\texttt{win\_before\_mean} & The player's winning chances before each of the moves, averaged, in percent. \\
\texttt{spent\_mean} & The seconds the player's moves took on average. \\
\texttt{spent\_median} & The median of the seconds the player's moves took. \\
\texttt{spent\_longest} & The most seconds one of the player's moves took. \\
\texttt{spent\_under\_2} & The share of the player's moves that took under 2 seconds. \\
\texttt{spent\_over\_30} & The share of the player's moves that took over 30 seconds. \\
\texttt{clock\_lowest} & The fewest seconds the player had on the clock before one of the moves. \\
\texttt{clock\_used} & The share of the starting time gone when the player made the last of the moves, which an increment can make negative. \\
\texttt{legal\_moves\_mean} & How many legal moves the player had, averaged over the moves. \\
\texttt{capture\_share} & The share of the player's moves that took something. \\
\texttt{check\_share} & The share of the player's moves that gave check. \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
